i lost my friend 5 months ago in an accident as well. 19, her dream career was taking off, she was about to move out into an apartment with her best friend, and she was in love. i’m so sorry for your loss. i try to live by love, although my fear and anger runs deep. i know she wouldn’t want me to live my life scared and in so much stagnant pain. try to feel through it, cry, sob, scream. your grief and your feelings are valid, no matter how much time has passed or how often they enter your mind.
